narrative: OMX30 enters Monday session with structural support: bull regime intact at +7.9% above 200-MA and ADX 28.7 confirming trend strength. However, technical deterioration flags caution—MACD bearish crossover with negative histogram (-1.238) and RSI 66.49 approaching overbought territory suggest mean reversion risk into resistance. Commodity tailwinds (copper +1.92%, gold +1.60%) favor industrials and mining, while US 10Y yield spike (+119bps) supports Nordic banks but pressures real estate. Asia's strong open (Hang Seng +179bps) and weighted correlation +0.187% provide modest positive bias, though US equity weakness and falling USD/SEK (-59bps) create cross-currents. Watch for consolidation near 3123 pivot with key resistance at 3180 (50-MA) and support at 3085 (lower Bollinger band).
morningBrief: OMX30 setup is BULLISH TACTICALLY but flagged for caution tactically. Bull market regime confirmed (200-MA +7.9%), but MACD bearish crossover and RSI 66 flag overbought conditions requiring pullback confirmation before fresh highs. Copper strength (+1.92%) and gold rally (+1.60%) unlock Boliden and heavy cyclicals; watch Atlas Copco and Volvo for industrial outperformance. Banks catch a bid from 10Y yield spike (4.696%) widening NIMs—SEB and Handelsbanken prime candidates. USD/SEK weakness (-59bps to 9.501) headwind for exporters; monitor Ericsson and Hexagon given NASDAQ -28bps. Avoid overextension; key resistance 3180 (50-MA), support 3085 (lower Bollinger). US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) key data point—expect volatility if miss. Risk-off headline potential (private credit strain, trade tensions) could trigger VIX spike and sell-off.
